# Dataset Exploration

```{r load}
source("R/utils.R")
source("R/01_data_loader.R")

DATA_PATH <- "data/raw/LUMIERE"
```

## Discover Structure

```{r discover}
structure <- discover_lumiere_structure(DATA_PATH)
cat("Total files:", structure$total_files, "\n")
cat("NIfTI files:", length(structure$nifti_files), "\n")
cat("CSV files:", length(structure$csv_files), "\n")
```

## Patient Index

```{r patients}
patients <- load_patient_index(DATA_PATH)
print(patients)

cat("\nPatients:", nrow(patients))
cat("\nMedian timepoints:", median(patients$n_timepoints, na.rm = TRUE))
cat("\nTotal NIfTI files:", sum(patients$n_nifti_files, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Clinical Data

```{r clinical}
clinical <- load_clinical_data(DATA_PATH)

for (name in names(clinical)) {
  cat("\n---", name, "---\n")
  cat("Rows:", nrow(clinical[[name]]), "\n")
  cat("Columns:", paste(names(clinical[[name]]), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

## Load One Patient

```{r one_patient}
first_patient <- patients$path[1]
patient <- load_full_patient(first_patient)

cat("Patient:", patient$patient_id, "\n")
cat("Timepoints:", length(patient$timepoints), "\n")

for (tp_name in names(patient$timepoints)) {
  tp <- patient$timepoints[[tp_name]]
  cat("\n  Timepoint:", tp_name, "\n")
  cat("  Modalities:", paste(tp$mri$available, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  Segmentation:", !is.null(tp$segmentation$mask), "\n")
  if (!is.null(tp$segmentation$mask)) {
    cat("  Seg labels:", paste(tp$segmentation$labels, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}
```

## Visualize MRI Slices

```{r visualize, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
library(ggplot2)

tp <- patient$timepoints[[1]]

plots <- list()
for (mod in tp$mri$available) {
  vol <- as.array(tp$mri$volumes[[mod]])
  mid_slice <- vol[, , dim(vol)[3] %/% 2]

  df <- expand.grid(x = seq_len(nrow(mid_slice)), y = seq_len(ncol(mid_slice)))
  df$intensity <- as.vector(mid_slice)

  plots[[mod]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y, fill = intensity)) +
    geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(title = toupper(mod)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

if (length(plots) > 0) {
  library(patchwork)
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2)
}
```

## Segmentation Overlay

```{r seg_overlay, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(tp$segmentation$mask) && length(tp$mri$available) > 0) {
  vol <- as.array(tp$mri$volumes[[tp$mri$available[1]]])
  seg <- as.array(tp$segmentation$mask)

  z <- dim(vol)[3] %/% 2
  mri_slice <- vol[, , z]
  seg_slice <- seg[, , z]

  df <- expand.grid(x = seq_len(nrow(mri_slice)), y = seq_len(ncol(mri_slice)))
  df$mri <- as.vector(mri_slice)
  df$seg <- factor(as.vector(seg_slice))

  ggplot(df) +
    geom_raster(aes(x, y, fill = mri)) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    geom_raster(aes(x, y, alpha = as.numeric(seg != "0")), fill = "red") +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(title = "MRI with Segmentation Overlay") +
    theme_void()
}
```
